categories.name: hdl-dsp-support
categories.description: HDL-compatible DSP System Toolbox blocks for FPGA implementation

customDescriptions.value: HDL-optimized DSP filters with streaming interfaces — use for hardware-targeted filtering when DSP System Toolbox algorithms must run on FPGA
HDL-compatible signal buffering and frame management blocks — use for signal alignment and rate adaptation in FPGA DSP pipelines
HDL-optimized signal processing operations — use for time-domain signal manipulation in hardware-targeted designs
HDL-compatible signal display and capture blocks — use for debugging and verification within HDL-targeted DSP subsystems
HDL-compatible signal generators for stimulus and test — use to provide input waveforms within HDL-targeted subsystems
HDL-optimized statistical computations on streaming data — use for running mean, variance, or histogram in FPGA signal processing
